hypothesis: The six offsets are six independent robustness tests
construction: compare mean-of-offsets with full-series mean; vary bootstrap block length
result: mean-of-offsets +0.1742 = full-series mean +0.1742; CI width grows 0.191->0.241 as block length 3->18
conclusion: REFUTED. Offsets are a start-date sensitivity diagnostic, not replication. v8/v9 robustness claims overstated; superseded by block bootstrap with L=2h.

sample: both samples, same discovery/validation split rule
result: see SENS table - IC and t move materially between samples
conclusion: Sample choice is itself a source of variation. Cross-version comparisons (v9 vs v10) are NOT like-for-like.
